LanguageData.MAP_MechanoidMechanitor.Scenario.EditorT: Mechanoid Mechanitor scenario: play as a mechanoid with self-awareness. After adding this part, the ordinary starting colonists of the current scenario will be replaced by the selected mechanoid mechanitor, and the save will enable a series of colony-specific effects exclusive to mechanoid mechanitors. \nNote: may conflict with some MOD scenarios.
